components.title: Delivery public boundary
components.rationale: src/index.ts exposes runtime delivery APIs for outbox movement, projection refresh, sharding and start-run backpressure admission.

components.title: Outbox delivery worker
components.rationale: Moves outbox facts through the delivery boundary and owns worker execution behavior.

components.title: Outbox worker runtime
components.rationale: Owns runtime looping, hook execution and bounded error handling around outbox delivery.

components.title: Projector worker runtime
components.rationale: Refreshes read-model projections from delivered facts using the delivery runtime boundary.

components.title: Outbox shard assignment
components.rationale: Deterministically assigns outbox work to shards for scale-out ownership.

components.title: Start-run backpressure admission
components.rationale: Applies delivery-pressure admission rules before allowing new run starts.

components.title: In-memory delivery test adapters
components.rationale: Testing-only event bus and outbox storage implementations used to prove delivery semantics.
